environment.stage: 1/2; independently builds the required runtime image before APISIX

environment.dockerfile_note: The exact accepted Dockerfile is the corrected file used by this successful direct build.

tests.command:
set -eu
printf '%s\n' '--- runtime image identity ---'
docker image inspect apache/apisix-runtime-deb:3.12.0 --format '{{.Id}} {{.Os}}/{{.Architecture}} size={{.Size}} title={{index .Config.Labels "org.opencontainers.image.title"}}'
printf '%s\n' '--- final image identity and parent ---'
docker image inspect apache/apisix:3.12.0 --format '{{.Id}} {{.Os}}/{{.Architecture}} size={{.Size}} parent={{.Parent}}'
printf '%s\n' '--- runtime consumer checks ---'
docker run --rm --entrypoint sh apache/apisix-runtime-deb:3.12.0 -ec 'luajit -e '\''assert(jit.arch == "loongarch64"); print(jit.arch, jit.version)'\''; openresty -V 2>&1 | head -n 3; ! ldd /usr/local/openresty/nginx/sbin/nginx | grep -F "not found"'
printf '%s\n' '--- final image consumer checks ---'
docker run --rm --entrypoint sh apache/apisix:3.12.0 -ec 'apisix version; luajit -e '\''assert(jit.arch == "loongarch64"); print(jit.arch, jit.version)'\''; openresty -t'
printf '%s\n' '--- final history begins from runtime ---'
docker history --no-trunc apache/apisix:3.12.0 | head -n 5

set -eu
name=apisix312-runtime-base-smoke
docker rm -f "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
trap 'docker rm -f "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
docker run -d --name "$name" \
  -v "$PWD/image-context/test-config/config.yaml:/usr/local/apisix/conf/config.yaml:ro" \
  -v "$PWD/image-context/test-config/apisix.yaml:/usr/local/apisix/conf/apisix.yaml:ro" \
  apache/apisix:3.12.0 >/dev/null
sleep 5
state=$(docker inspect "$name" --format '{{.State.Status}}')
test "$state" = running
printf 'state=%s\n' "$state"
docker exec "$name" /usr/local/openresty/luajit/bin/luajit -e 'local socket=require("socket"); local s=assert(socket.tcp()); s:settimeout(5); assert(s:connect("127.0.0.1",9080)); assert(s:send("GET /get HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: localhost\r\n\r\n")); local line=assert(s:receive("*l")); print(line); assert(line:find("503",1,true), "expected unavailable web1 upstream HTTP 503"); s:close()'
if docker logs "$name" 2>&1 | grep -Ei 'SIGSEGV|segmentation fault|pcre jit stack allocation failed'; then exit 1; fi
printf '%s\n' 'startup smoke passed: YAML route responded; APISIX remained running without PCRE JIT or worker crash'

set -eu
for image in apache/apisix-runtime-deb:3.12.0 apache/apisix:3.12.0; do
  docker image inspect "$image" --format 'image={{index .RepoTags 0}} id={{.Id}} os={{.Os}} arch={{.Architecture}} size={{.Size}} layers={{len .RootFS.Layers}} env={{json .Config.Env}}'
done

dependencies.name: APISIX runtime base image
dependencies.consumer: Required FROM base for Stage 2 apache/apisix:3.12.0

dependencies.name: Loongson LuaJIT
dependencies.consumer: OpenResty runtime JIT and Lua ABI

dependencies.name: APISIX application rootfs
dependencies.architecture: LoongArch64 Lua modules and application files
dependencies.consumer: Copied into the required runtime image in Stage 2

required_files: image-context/apisix-rootfs/ (prepare from APISIX commit and recorded install commands)
environment_assumptions: Native LoongArch64 Docker daemon; no emulation
The pinned Debian base is available
Both prepared rootfs trees are present in image-context
Build Stage 1 and retain its local tag before Stage 2
APISIX and API7 source artifacts are acquired at recorded commits
